# Building evidence for better AI governance.

Exploring how empirical research, quantitative methods, and public policy can inform the governance of AI systems and their societal impacts.
:::

<br>


## Areas of Focus

Connecting empirical evidence, technical evaluation, and public policy to support better decisions about AI.

::: {.research-grid}

::: {.research-card}
<div class="focus-tag">AI Governance</div>

### Who should be accountable for AI?

Institutions, Accountability, and Public Policy.
:::

::: {.research-card}
<div class="focus-tag">AI Safety & Risk</div>

### How can we prevent AI-related harm?

Evaluation, Uncertainty, and Oversight.
:::

::: {.research-card}
<div class="focus-tag">Societal Impact</div>

### How does AI affect people and society?

Sustainability, AI Impact Assessment, Public Interest, and Real-World Consequences.
:::

::: {.research-card}
<div class="focus-tag">Empirical Methods</div>

### What works, for whom, and why?

Statistics, Causal Inference, Machine Learning, and Impact Evaluation.
:::
